beats.title: Lizards at Gomat Oasis
beats.boundaryReason: The session opens with the party surveying the giant lizards and ruined camp at Gomat, then ends this beat as they commit to the attack and roll initiative.
dateEvidence: session.yaml starts the session on 1748-03-23
the opening recap and scene description explicitly place the arrival at sunset and in early night

beats.title: Battle at Gomat
beats.boundaryReason: The beat begins with initiative and contains the complete fight against the three giant lizards, ending once the last creature falls.
dateEvidence: the fight follows directly from the sunset approach
the transcript explicitly identifies the scene as early night

beats.title: Night at the Oasis
beats.boundaryReason: After the battle, the party searches the bodies and tents, considers the lizards' strange behavior, and camps through an uneventful night.
dateEvidence: the DM says the night is still and quiet after combat
the beat ends with watches and a long rest immediately before the next morning

beats.title: Tracks in Morning Light
beats.boundaryReason: Morning light reveals the attack site and eastbound tracks; the party dissects a lizard before a wounded rider reaches the oasis.
dateEvidence: the transcript explicitly says the morning comes after the March 23 long rest
the sun is rising while the party investigates the camp

beats.title: Akan Returns to Gomat
beats.boundaryReason: The rider identifies himself as Akan, recounts the fatal lizard attack, retrieves the survivors and supplies, and helps frame the danger east of Gomat before the party departs.
dateEvidence: Akan arrives during the same morning investigation
no rest or time jump occurs before the party decides to continue east

beats.title: East into the Nashtkar
beats.boundaryReason: The party follows the lizard trail east, discusses elves and dreams during the journey, and finds further evidence of unnaturally violent animals before evening approaches.
dateEvidence: the road journey begins in mid-morning after the party leaves Gomat
the DM says the group talks and travels through the day until it is getting toward evening

beats.title: Camping Above Daraar Canyon
beats.boundaryReason: The party reaches the unnatural canyon late in the day, scouts a route down, discovers signs of a concealed earlier camp, and spends a fitful but uninterrupted night above the descent.
dateEvidence: the canyon appears in the late-afternoon sun with about an hour until sunset
the party makes camp and sleeps before the transcript announces the next morning

beats.title: Crossing Daraar Canyon
beats.boundaryReason: On the next morning, the party shelters Delwath's horse, descends into Daraar Canyon, and follows converging animal tracks toward the gentler eastern ascent.
dateEvidence: the transcript explicitly begins this beat with the next morning after the March 24 camp
the descent and tracking occur continuously without another rest

beats.title: The Bloodthirsty Wilds
beats.boundaryReason: Beyond the canyon, the landscape and its animals display pervasive aggression as the party follows the ruined road toward two distant towers.
dateEvidence: the eastward ascent follows directly from the morning canyon crossing
the DM says it is about lunchtime by the time the party reaches the final approach

beats.title: Ruined Fort and Mounds
beats.boundaryReason: The party studies the abandoned fort, its ruined outbuildings, and the paired grassy and rubble mounds until Kenzo senses undead near the causeway.
dateEvidence: the fort survey follows immediately from the lunchtime approach
there is no intervening rest or travel transition

beats.title: Skeletons from the Earth
beats.boundaryReason: Skeletal arms emerge from the disturbed rubble mound, beginning a complete combat that ends when Kenzo shatters the last skeleton.
dateEvidence: the undead emerge during the same midday fort approach
the fight proceeds without a time or location break

beats.title: Reading the Disturbed Ground
beats.boundaryReason: After the battle, the party investigates the recently disturbed mound, identifies the fort's Great War design, and enters the fort as the session ends.
dateEvidence: the investigation begins immediately after the skeleton fight
the party enters the fort without another travel or rest transition
